process_area.title: Contingent Worker Onboarding, Access & Time Operations

fields.Frequency: Daily for recurring services; event-driven for projects
fields.Participants: Contingent Workforce Coordinator, User Dept (Store/DC/HQ), Agency, Contingent Workforce Mgr
fields.Trigger: Operating need (shift coverage, project, event); scheduled or ad-hoc
fields.Volume: ~200 stores + 4 DCs + HQ with recurring crews; ad-hoc project demand

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "headcount, location, date/time window, scope/SOW reference" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-send of "sends worker roster" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "On completion, User Dept confirms deliverables/coverage against SOW" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-524 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Worker Onboarding, Access & Time Operations (PA-98.2).)
- operational: PO/work-order gating; operational: SLA penalty (W3212) and multi-supplier pool
Pain Points / Risks: - **Off-contract dispatch risk**: Engagement of non-preferred supplier bypasses compliance; mitigated by PO/work-order gating
- **No-show/coverage risk**: Agency fails to staff; mitigated by SLA penalty (W3212) and multi-supplier pool
System Touchpoints: - Work-order/VM5 (links to VS-34); agency portal; time capture (W3220); invoice (W3221)

steps.activity: User Dept raise work order/requisition: category, headcount, location, date/time window, scope/SOW reference (W3212), special requirements; route through Contingent Workforce Coordinator for approved-supplier dispatch

Coordinator dispatches to approved agency (W3210) per MSA/SLA (W3213); agency confirms worker assignment and sends worker roster (not individual direction by BuildRight — W3211); coordinator confirms acceptance and pre-engagement screening (W3223)
On completion, User Dept confirms deliverables/coverage against SOW (W3220/W3221); coordinator closes work order and triggers time capture (W3220) and invoice flow (W3221); log exceptions

fields.Participants: Coordinator, HR (links to VS-19), Safety (links to VS-24), Security (links to VS-23), IT (links to VS-27 for system access), Agency
fields.Trigger: New contractor worker assigned to a BuildRight site

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "record worker personal data per Data Privacy Act" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Issue site badge" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document completion before site entry" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-524 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Worker Onboarding, Access & Time Operations (PA-98.2).)
- operational: time-limited badges and access review (W3216); operational: purpose-limited collection and consent (links to VS-91)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stale-access risk**: Departed workers retain access; mitigated by time-limited badges and access review (W3216)
- **Privacy risk**: Over-collection of contractor personal data; mitigated by purpose-limited collection and consent (links to VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - Contingent workforce system (links to VS-29); access control (links to VS-23.2); IT identity (links to VS-27); privacy (links to VS-91)

steps.activity: Coordinator registers contractor worker in contingent-workforce system (distinct from BuildRight employee master — links to VS-29 extended masters): name, agency, role/category, assignment location/duration, emergency contact, screening status (W3223), photo for badge; record worker personal data per Data Privacy Act (links to VS-91) with consent

Issue site badge (visual + access control): contractor badge visually distinct from employee badge; time-limited to assignment; access scoped to assigned areas only (not back-office systems); enroll in access-control system (links to VS-23.2 physical security); collect and log access

Complete onboarding checklist: safety orientation (W3219), asset/uniform if applicable (W3222), system access if required (minimal — links to VS-27 least-privilege), site orientation; document completion before site entry

fields.Participants: Safety Officer (links to VS-24), User Dept, Contractor Supervisor, Worker
fields.Trigger: First site assignment; high-risk task (hot work, working at height, electrical, confined space)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "Safety Officer deliver general contractor safety orientation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "For high-risk tasks, issue permit-to-work" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "record violations and feed contractor scorecard" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: no-orientation-no-entry rule and PTW; operational: spot-checks and stop-work authority
Pain Points / Risks: - **Untrained-worker risk**: Contractor worker without orientation/competency causes incident; mitigated by no-orientation-no-entry rule and PTW
- **Compliance-drift risk**: PTW/PPE compliance erodes over time; mitigated by spot-checks and stop-work authority
System Touchpoints: - Permit-to-work/CMMS (links to VS-20.3); HSE (links to VS-24); contractor scorecard (W3225)

steps.activity: Safety Officer deliver general contractor safety orientation: site hazards (forklifts, racking, chemicals, electrical, slips/trips/falls), emergency procedures (links to VS-24.2), PPE requirements (links to VS-24.1), incident reporting (W3228), BuildRight HSE rules; quiz/acknowledgement before site entry

For high-risk tasks, issue permit-to-work (PTW): hot work, working at height, electrical live work, confined space, excavation, lockout-tagout (LOTO); verify competency/certification (e.g., scaffold erector, forklift operator per VS-06.2), isolation, fire watch, rescue plan; PTW time-boxed and signed off

Monitor compliance: Safety/Store Ops spot-check PTW and PPE compliance; enforce stop-work authority for unsafe conditions; record violations and feed contractor scorecard (W3225) and HSE metrics (links to VS-24.1)

fields.Participants: Coordinator, User Dept, Agency, Contractor Supervisor

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "log, promodizer report" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-post of "posts/coverage met, deliverables completed to standard, exceptions" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "System aggregates approved time/deliverables for billing" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-524 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Worker Onboarding, Access & Time Operations (PA-98.2).)
- operational: biometric capture, deliverable confirmation, and audit (W3221); operational: SLA and daily confirmation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Time-fraud risk**: Inflated/phantom timesheets; mitigated by biometric capture, deliverable confirmation, and audit (W3221)
- **Coverage-gap risk**: Short-staffing degrades service; mitigated by SLA and daily confirmation
System Touchpoints: - Time-and-attendance; access-control feed (W3218); work-order (W3217); billing feed (W3221)

steps.activity: Agency/Contractor Supervisor capture worker time-in/time-out per shift (biometric or badge per W3218 access-control) and deliverables completed (cleaning checklist, security log, promodizer report); submit daily timesheet/deliverable record to BuildRight
User Dept/Coordinator confirm coverage and deliverables against SOW (W3212): required posts/coverage met, deliverables completed to standard, exceptions (absence, shortfall, quality issues) flagged
System aggregates approved time/deliverables for billing (W3221); reconcile to work orders (W3217) and SLA (W3225); flag anomalies (overtime, coverage gaps) for review

fields.Participants: Coordinator, User Dept, Finance/AP (links to VS-15), Procurement (links to VS-34)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "verify headcount/shifts/hours, rates, SLA credits/penalties" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-route of "route for approval per authority matrix" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-capture of "User Dept/Coordinator approve service acceptance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-524 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Worker Onboarding, Access & Time Operations (PA-98.2).)
- operational: reconciliation and tolerance checks; operational: AP controls (links to VS-79)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Overbilling risk**: Invoices exceed contracted rates/approved hours; mitigated by reconciliation and tolerance checks
- **Tax-noncompliance risk**: Missed EWT/VAT; mitigated by AP controls (links to VS-79)
System Touchpoints: - AP/invoice (links to VS-15); tax/EWT (links to VS-79); expense (links to VS-34.3); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Coordinator reconcile agency invoice to approved time/deliverables (W3220) and contracted rate card (W3213): verify headcount/shifts/hours, rates, SLA credits/penalties (W3212), wage-order pass-through adjustments; flag variances > tolerance

Finance/AP (links to VS-15) validate supplier master, PO/contract reference, BIR-compliant invoice (links to VS-79 e-invoicing), withholding tax (EWT on services per VS-79.2 — expanded withholding), VAT; route for approval per authority matrix

User Dept/Coordinator approve service acceptance (deliverables met); Finance processes payment (links to VS-15.2); post to correct cost center/category (links to VS-34.3 expense monitoring); retain records (links to VS-88)

fields.Participants: Coordinator, User Dept, Facilities/Stores (links to VS-07/VS-20.3), Asset Mgmt (links to VS-35), Agency

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "record issuance against worker/agency in asset-tracking" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "During assignment, maintain accountability" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document recovery or loss" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-524 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Worker Onboarding, Access & Time Operations (PA-98.2).)
- operational: recovery-before-exit and chargeback; operational: hygiene and assignment discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **Asset-leakage risk**: Unreturned assets at worker exit; mitigated by recovery-before-exit and chargeback
- **Cross-contamination risk**: Shared tools/uniforms across workers; mitigated by hygiene and assignment discipline
System Touchpoints: - Asset tracking (links to VS-35/VS-99); access control (links to VS-23.2/W3218); HSE (links to VS-24.1)

steps.activity: Coordinator/Facilities issue BuildRight-provided assets to contractor workers where required (PPE, radio, keys, uniform, badge, mobile device, RF gun per VS-99); record issuance against worker/agency in asset-tracking (links to VS-35/VS-99); agency-provided assets (uniforms, cleaning equipment) remain agency responsibility

During assignment, maintain accountability: periodic asset audit, replacement of worn/damaged items, chargeback for loss where contractually permitted; ensure PPE replaced per HSE schedule (links to VS-24.1)
On exit (W3216), recover all BuildRight-issued assets before final access revocation and final invoice settlement (W3221); document recovery or loss; revoke badge/access (W3218)

fields.Participants: Coordinator, Agency, Legal/Compliance, Security (links to VS-23)
fields.Volume: All contractor workers (security, cash-handling, child-adjacent roles critical)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records for cash-handling/security roles" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "Coordinator/Security verify authenticity" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-524 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Worker Onboarding, Access & Time Operations (PA-98.2).)
- operational: mandatory screening and re-screening; operational: screening and re-screening; operational: documented process and legal review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Insider-threat risk**: Unscreened worker commits theft/fraud (links to VS-23.1/W3229); mitigated by mandatory screening and re-screening
- **Privacy/due-process risk**: Adverse action on screening findings; mitigated by documented process and legal review
System Touchpoints: - Worker record/screening (links to VS-29); privacy (links to VS-91); security (links to VS-23)

steps.activity: Agency conducts and certifies pre-engagement screening per category: NBI clearance (or barangay clearance per W555 provincial context), police clearance, prior-employment/reference checks, drug test where lawful/relevant, court records for cash-handling/security roles; provide certification to BuildRight

Coordinator/Security verify authenticity (NBI certificate verification, agency credentials); for high-risk roles (security, CIT links to VS-81, cash-handling, IT admin), require enhanced screening and BuildRight Security review; reject where disqualifying findings

Record screening in worker record (links to VS-29/VS-91 privacy controls); periodic re-screening for long-tenured contractor workers; manage adverse-action due process (DOLE/NLRC) where screening grounds removal

fields.Participants: User Dept (Store Mgr/DC Mgr/HQ Mgr), Contractor Supervisor, Coordinator, Safety
fields.Volume: All active contractor crews across 200 stores + 4 DCs + HQ

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "User Dept supervises to the SOW" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-escalate of "escalate conduct/performance issues to contractor supervisor and coordinator" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "Coordinator aggregates daily observations into periodic performance review" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-524 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Worker Onboarding, Access & Time Operations (PA-98.2).)
- operational: supervisor training (W3211) and contractor-supervisor channel; operational: daily checks and scorecard (W3225)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Boundary-violation risk**: BuildRight supervisor crosses into employer functions (directing discipline/pay); mitigated by supervisor training (W3211) and contractor-supervisor channel
- **Quality-erosion risk**: Unmonitored performance declines; mitigated by daily checks and scorecard (W3225)
System Touchpoints: - Work-order/exception log; HSE (links to VS-24); scorecard feed (W3225)

steps.activity: User Dept supervises to the SOW (not as employer — W3211 four-fold test): confirm coverage, conduct quality check (cleaning standard, security post, promodizer activity), document exceptions; coordinate through contractor supervisor for corrective action (not direct worker discipline)

User Dept/Safety monitor HSE compliance and conduct (PPE, conduct toward customers/staff, no prohibited activities); apply stop-work for safety issues (W3219); escalate conduct/performance issues to contractor supervisor and coordinator
Coordinator aggregates daily observations into periodic performance review (W3225) and incident feed (W3228); route systemic issues to contract management (W3216)
